issue.title: Subscriptions album: records that know how they show up on the statement
issue.description: A 🔁 Subscriptions album under bank holds every discretionary recurring charge, seeded from a reviewed bank history. bob bank import links each new matching row to its record, and the link renders as a quiet 🔁 chip. bob bank check and bob bank subscriptions keep the album honest: they flag price changes, charges after a cancel, and possible new subscriptions. The old Zorg recurring table retires without losing a link, and bob-cli-kt closes.
